dimensions.name: GROUNDING
findings: Re-verified directly against the real algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve source cloned at scratchpad/openevolve: controller.py:248-251 `_load_initial_program()` does `with open(...) as f: return f.read()` (whole file); process_parallel.py:263 `child_code = apply_diff(parent.code, llm_response, ...)` (whole parent.code) and process_parallel.py:278 full-rewrite path `child_code = new_code` (entire file, zero scoping); prompt/templates.py's DIFF_USER_TEMPLATE (lines 23-34) shows `{current_program}` in full with only 'Focus on making targeted changes' guidance, no EVOLVE-BLOCK-respecting instruction; `parse_evolve_blocks` (code_utils.py:9) is exported from utils/__init__.py but a repo-wide grep shows it is called from NOWHERE else — confirmed dead code w.r.t. enforcement. The spec's 'Scope of the strategy program' section, REQ-DL2, and INV-3 now state plainly that openevolve provides NO structural enforcement and that scope_guard.py is the sole enforcement — this now matches the verified source exactly. Findings #1/#6/#7 from iteration-1 are GENUINELY fixed, not papered over.

REQ-OE5's num_islands citation re-verified against real openevolve README.md (line 186: 'Island-Based Architecture: Multiple populations prevent premature convergence'; line 810: 'Diversity maintenance: MAP-Elites prevents convergence') and configs/README.md (line 44: 'num_islands: 3-10 for most problems (more = more diversity)') — both quotes match verbatim. The spec now correctly separates this diversity/anti-premature-convergence rationale from non-stationarity, and correctly assigns non-stationarity handling to REQ-EV3/RH5's rotated walk-forward windows (Lopez de Prado), not islands. Sutton & Barto §2.4 is now used only for REQ-GR4's hypothetical future-bandit recency-weighting citation, never for num_islands. Finding #2 GENUINELY fixed.

config.py re-verified: `DatabaseConfig.num_islands: int = 5` (line 308) and `EvaluatorConfig.cascade_thresholds: List[float] = [0.5, 0.75, 0.9]` (line 371) both confirmed exactly as the spec's UNVERIFIED section claims.

The Weng STOP quote in REQ-OE4 ('STOP improved performance with GPT-4 but DEGRADED with weaker models (GPT-3.5, Mixtral)... The base model must be capable enough') and the 'Evaluator/permission should sit OUTSIDE the loop that evolves harness' quote were checked verbatim against docs/loop-engineering/06-harness-engineering-weng.md lines 40 and 55 (① and ② respectively) — both match exactly.

summary: PASS on all 6 dimensions. All 8 iteration-1 blocking findings are GENUINELY resolved, verified independently against the real algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve source (cloned at scratchpad/openevolve) rather than taken on the builder's word: (1/6/7) the false EVOLVE-BLOCK-structural-enforcement claim is corrected everywhere (Scope-of-the-strategy-program section, REQ-DL2, INV-3) and scope_guard.py is now stated, accurately, as the sole enforcement mechanism, wired as evaluate_stage1's first operation (REQ-DL5) -- re-confirmed via controller.py:_load_initial_program (f.read(), whole file), process_parallel.py (apply_diff over parent.code; full-rewrite child_code = new_code), prompt/templates.py (shows the entire current_program, no marker-respecting instruction), and utils/code_utils.py (parse_evolve_blocks exported but never called anywhere in the real generation/evaluation path); (2) REQ-OE5's num_islands citation now correctly points to openevolve's own README.md/configs/README.md diversity rationale (verbatim-matched) rather than Sutton & Barto, with non-stationarity correctly handled by REQ-EV3/RH5's rotated walk-forward windows; (3) REQ-OE7 adds a concrete, testable launchd-based zero-human recurring trigger for run_evolve.sh, and the Purpose section disambiguates LOOP 1 (this feature's own dev-branch self-merge, standing process, no new mechanism needed) from LOOP 2 (REQ-OE7); (4) the Done table now has a distinct 'impl review' row for a standard VCSDD Phase-3 adversary review of the harness's OWN source files, explicitly distinguished from REQ-RH4 step 3's per-candidate runtime gate; (5) Weng's STOP warning is now cited verbatim in REQ-OE4 with a correctly-matched mitigation (deterministic evaluator + strong-model adversary outside the loop); (8) the Architecture Decision correctly abandons pick.py as the evolvable unit (verified: pick.py is a live 3-model BlockRun consensus + live network-fetch script per direct read) in favor of a new self-contained pm_backtest_strategy.py, with the pick.py integration honestly deferred to a later, unspecified phase. No new problems were introduced by these fixes: the pivot away from pick.py additionally and correctly resolves a second CONSISTENCY & SAFETY concern from iteration-1 (free-tier LLM no longer ever sees wallet-adjacent code, since pm_backtest_strategy.py contains none). One minor, non-blocking observation for implementers: /goal condition (6) 'committed+pushed' has no dedicated Done-table row, but this is already governed by a standing, blanket project rule (global CLAUDE.md, git-workflow.md) independent of this spec, treated consistently with how the spec treats LOOP1 self-merge. Spec is ready to proceed to TDD (Phase 2a).
